comments.author: Skulltag
comments.body_html:
ohh damn, you’re right. I wonder if this was also the case in older SPT versions. I’m not really sure how to scale it properly though. I just call this function when you purchase bands. I have no idea why it gives different skill exp amounts based on your skill level.

profileHelper.addSkillPointsToPlayer(pmcData, skillName as SkillTypes, config.skillExp * buyData.count);

I took a quick look at how skill XP is stored on the server and it’s kinda funky. apparently it stores xp for each skill between 0 and 5100 with every 100 xp being 1 skill level capping at 51.

So even though it shows you need 10 xp to go from lvl 0 to 1, you actually need 100 xp on the server side. that’s probably why you only get 0.1xp on the client side at lvl 0 from 1 band with default config settings.
